prompt: In shop/, the staging dry run (`graph-agents-cli deploy --env staging --dry-run`) fails with exit code 3. For staging, the inventory API is at https://inventory.staging.acme.internal. Fix it and prove that the dry run passes.

checks.why: an environment's URL goes into that environment's values file
values.yaml is shared by every environment: the staging URL must not reach prod

reference: Exit 3 is the CHANGE-ME placeholder `api add` left for INVENTORY_API_BASE_URL in the chart env (refused outside dev). Set `env: {INVENTORY_API_BASE_URL: https://inventory.staging.acme.internal}` in values-staging.yaml (keep APP_ENV there; values.yaml stays the placeholder for other environments), then `graph-agents-cli deploy --env staging --dry-run` passes.
